answers.answer: D) Pause the discussion and explicitly invite input: I'd like to hear from everyone. [Name], you've been working closest to this module — what's your take? This approach creates psychological safety by actively inviting quieter voices while validating their expertise. It's specific and actionable without putting anyone on the spot awkwardly.
